oneOf.description: Reconcile all active conversations on reconnect.
First and only request on a separate authenticated bidirectional stream.
Ephemeral CLI dialogs are replayed as a current-state snapshot, never as approvals.
Same delivery/ledger semantics as Prompt. The attempt UUID is diagnostic only.

Starts a role-based stream. Single-request bulk streams use their typed request
instead. Iroh authenticates the connection; this role conveys no authority.
This intent never follows a change of visible chat.

attemptId.description: Present only when chat timing was negotiated; excluded from retry identity.

createIfMissing.description: A new phone draft supplies a stable random v4 UUID before its first ACK.

base64.description: Canonical unpadded base64url, never a URL or a local path. PNG/JPEG only.

PiFrame.description:
Bounded fragments of an unmodified Pi event or get_entries response. The
epoch/sequence is an in-memory snapshot barrier, not another transcript cursor.

ReplyNotification.description: Host-generated after a successful phone turn, never available to notification tools.

tag.description: A new request ID can replace this host's earlier tag. Reusing an ID is never an update.
